(ORDER LIST: 607 U.S.)
WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 11, 2026
CERTIORARI DENIED
25-6754 SIMPSON, KENDRICK V. QUICK, WARDEN, ET AL.
(25A897)
The application for stay of execution of sentence of death
presented to Justice Gorsuch and by him referred to the Court is
denied. The petition for a writ of certiorari is denied.
